item.title: Diagram prompts with ChatGPT and AIPRM (PlantUML, Mermaid, and more)
item.description: I got tired of one-off ChatGPT threads that “draw a sequence diagram” and return half-random syntax. AIPRM helps because the template lives in the browser; I lock four fields — diagram type, elements, purpose, tool — and the model stops guessing whether I want PlantUML, Mermaid, or notes for Draw.io. Related: the D2C OpenAI diagram plugin post. Version française.
